ValidationRule.description: Restrict the QCC users from changing the case status when there is no contact linked to the QCC case
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND($Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.VR_Please_update_contact_in_QCC_cases__c = TRUE, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_Baggage', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_Complaints', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_Compliment', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_Further_Action_Required', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'QCC_Insurance_Letter_Case', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_Medical', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_On_The_Spot_Recovery', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_Query', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'QCC_Elite_Process', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'QCC_Assistance', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'QCC_Disruption', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'QCC_Specific_Needs', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_Refund' ), ISCHANGED(Status), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Status ),"New"),ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Status ),"In Progress")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status , "In Progress")), ISBLANK(ContactId ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please associate contact to the case before changing the status. If the customer is not a FF member then the null contact should be associated
